chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: Why he decided to sell himself as a single
summary: He tires of responsibility for sidemen's taxes, drinking and transport and travels alone, wanting this tape to record a musician's struggles after Condon's.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: And, so, this is what I went through with this whole thing. Until I got around to the point where I thought - well, why the hell am I breaking my back with bands -- why am I trying to do this. I'd sit down and talk to myself about it. Why don't I just sell myself; and from that point on, I've been doing just that as you know - travelling around the world; I don't have any responsibility of anybody else's taxes and I don't have the responsibility of somebody getting drunk and falling off the bandstand; I don't have any of those problems or worry about their transportation; all I have to do is worry about myself--
And, that's what I've been doing. But, I thought it would be a good idea to make this tape --

---just to give people -- or people that might be listening to this tape - what a musician went through in that period - from the end of the Condon days when our kind of music started to slip away. Of course, it never slipped away all the way because I told you - I went through that whole thing and kept busy enough to pay my rent and do all the things, but I think it's a very foolish thing for a person to go on working their brains out and never be able to put a cent in the bank.

And, that's what I wasn't able to do. I was just able to make it; and it used to drive my wife crazy - with all the expenses I had and when it came out to my end what's left, I didn't have very much left so that's the way it was.
